range_note: Ranges are per week. At 20 or more drinks, Critical takes precedence. For fractional weekly averages, Elevated starts at 8 for women or 15 for men; values below those thresholds stay in Low risk.
caveat: Project-defined informational categories, not validated probabilities of liver disease or a clinical severity scale. Low risk does not mean drinking is safe. This separate indicator does not change the model prediction.

warning_messages.elevated: Alcohol warning: {drinks} drinks/week meets or exceeds the heavy-drinking threshold.
warning_messages.critical: High alcohol intake: {drinks} drinks/week. Discuss your drinking with a healthcare professional.
